note: 26 Nov 2026, second try of the hard-maths sweep. Try 1 (25 Nov, 68f7134 then bccda8c, about $3.85 in all): the as-built brain looped on 63% of 150 MATH level-5 practice problems and got 37% right at about 13,500 tokens per answer (the same on the 60 check problems), so the failure is real here; the first trial then died 34 min in with 'socket hang up' and no trial finished. Now: answers stream (no silent connection to cut), a lost connection reruns the trial with its dials set again, and progress.json keeps every finished stage so --resume carries on. Smaller to fit: find 100, check 40, top 16 and 64 experts, down x0.5, up x1.3, both: 6 trials. Estimate from try 1's speed (about 1.07 min per answer per slot): find 107 min, trace 11, as built 41, trials 6 x 41 = about 6.8 h. Same practice set, never held-out. Caps 8 h / $5.
